alerts.title: Personnel SOS activated
alerts.detail: An emergency SOS was activated by a field technician near Separator S-201. Confirm the person’s condition and contact the zone response team.

alerts.title: Restricted zone entry
alerts.detail: A personnel location sample indicates entry into the restricted separator maintenance area. Verify the permit and coordinate with the zone supervisor.

alerts.title: PPE non-compliance detected
alerts.detail: The demonstration analytics event indicates a missing hard hat near Gas Compression. Review camera evidence and verify with the zone supervisor before taking action.

alerts.title: Camera connection lost
alerts.detail: Two cameras at the Wellhead Towers are unavailable. Request a VMS connectivity check and confirm alternate monitoring coverage.
